Subject: Interest in dedicated GPU pool for inference workloads

Vanessa —

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. Zephyr is evaluating a dedicated GPU pool to serve our clinical NLP scoring and real-time prioritization pipeline. Key asks: predictable P99 latency under 500ms for 1k concurrent inference requests, a committed pool sized for sustained throughput (models ~7B quantized), and an operational SLA.

We have an internal budget target but are also reviewing a competing reserved offering from HaloAI that includes an initial onboarding credit. Can you share a written proposal with: proposed pool sizing, throughput guarantees, commit term options (12/24 months), and any available onboarding/usage credits? Procurement would like to see a line-by-line comparison.

Appreciate it — happy to loop in Karolina from engineering if needed.

— Alex

Great to connect. Attached is a compact proposal (see Zephyr_SOW_v3.pdf) and a short pricing comparison sheet. Summary highlights:
- Recommended pool: 48 A10-equivalent GPUs (sustained target ~1.0k reqs/s for your 7B quantized model family), with autoscale headroom to 64 for bursts.
- Throughput & latency: validated 99th P99 < 450ms at target concurrency in our benchmark suite; 99.9% availability SLA for dedicated pools.
- Commit options: 12-month and 24-month tiers. Pricing shown as $65,000/month (12m commit) or $58,500/month (24m commit) for the baseline 48-GPU pool.
- Onboarding: standard 2-week migration assistance plus a $25k one-time credit if signed within 30 days.

We understand procurement is comparing offers — I can propose an additional commercial concession to match competitive credits if you share the competing offer details. Would you and procurement be open to a quick 20-minute call tomorrow?

Attached: Zephyr_SOW_v3.pdf, pricing_comparison.xlsx
